title: Hearing on reforming the Third-Party Transfer program
summary: The Council's Housing and Buildings Committee is examining the Third Party Transfer (TPT) program, which lets the city foreclose on tax-delinquent, distressed properties and transfer them to third parties for rehabilitation. The hearing will also consider Int. No. 657, a bill that would repeal and rewrite several sections of the administrative code governing TPT and delinquent tax payment agreements. TPT has been paused since 2018 after its last round left 62 properties transferred, including many co-ops, and drew lawsuits and complaints about inadequate notice to owners.
